title: Composition of ordered Tate pullback along arbitrary maps
statement: For composable scheme maps p:T→U and v:U→S with specified composite w, the canonical ordered shifted Tate coefficient pullback along w is the inverse-image compositor followed by pullback of transport along v and then transport along p. The intermediate invertibility proofs may be supplied independently.

proof.text: Prove the normalized line comparison composition equation on roots generators and transport it through degree-zero realization and shift.
Induct on the ordered tensor power: use the constant-unit composition equation at zero and monoidal pullback composition with the shifted-line equation at a successor.

theorem vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback_comp (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (N : ℕ)
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {T U S : Scheme.{u}} (p : T ⟶ U) (v : U ⟶ S) (w : T ⟶ S)
    (hw : w = p ≫ v) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (hU : IsUnit (N : Γ(U, ⊤))) (d : ℕ) :
    (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p v w hw).hom.app
        (affineLinearBaseCoefficient A N hA S d) ≫
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A p).map
        (vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback A N hA t v hS d).hom ≫
      (vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback A N hA t p hU d).hom =
        (vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback A N hA t w hS d).hom
